checked.claim: fixed: the window's close and throwDice spend by name; the second spend finds nothing
checked.why: consumeCall is gone and spendCallsByNonce writes only when the flag still holds a named entry. But 'throwDice's own spend then finds none' assumes the close hook's write has landed first. Both read `pendingCallsRaw(actor)` from the local document. onCloseApplication awaits an import before its spend and is not awaited by the roll. throwDice spends the same nonces for any roll not drawn.
